svg.title: Design system: Dusk and Vellum themes, typography, syntax colours and the evening star accent.

g.text: Dusk ink, bone type, one evening star
Jost for every line of interface copy
Evening star gold is for emphasis
It marks the caret, the Run button and unsaved files, and nothing else competes with it.
Everything else stays silver and bone, so the one thing that matters is always the brightest.
